name: Trưng Sisters' kingdom
alt: Zheng sisters (Zheng Ce and Zheng Er)

predecessors.name: Han dynasty
predecessors.text: the sixty-five strongholds of Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen and Rinan (Hepu, which 'rose in response', lies east of the shape)

successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: the sixty-five strongholds of Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen and Rinan (Hepu, which 'rose in response', lies east of the shape)

ledger.x: 40: the Trưng sisters rise at Mê Linh and take sixty-five strongholds.
42: Ma Yuan's army arrives; the Battle of Lãng Bạc.
43: the sisters defeated and killed; Jiaozhi returns to the Han.
43: the fighting in the delta ends with the sisters' death.
43: the rebellion is over; Han magistrates installed.

wars.name: Ma Yuan's campaign against the Trưng sisters (42–43)
wars.outcome: Han victory: Lãng Bạc in the spring of 42, the sisters beheaded in 43, Jiuzhen pacified in the tenth month of 43; Ma Yuan 'returned to the capital' in the autumn of 44.

certainty.note: The sixty-five strongholds are the commandery seats of Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen and Rinan; the shape is Cliopatria's and Hepu's adherence is not drawn.
